text:
maria.g: Hey payroll team — noticed my Feb paystub shows CA withholding even though I moved to NY on Feb 10. Net pay is lower than expected and the CA state line looks like a full-month. Screenshot attached. Anyone know if this is a syncing issue or something else?

leo: @maria.g thanks for flagging — did you update your home address in Ripley HR before the payroll cutoff? If the change landed after cutoff it could have missed the run. Also did you submit a NY state withholding form or new state W-4?

maria.g: I updated my address in Ripley HR on Feb 12 (I thought it synced automatically). I didn't realize payroll cutoff was Feb 9. I haven't submitted a NY state withholding form yet.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-1123 — Assigned to @ana. Expected triage within 2 business days.

ana: Hi @maria.g — sorry about the trouble. Can you DM me the Feb paystub PDF and confirm the exact relocation date? We'll check whether we can do a retro allocation vs issuing a refund on the next payrun.

maria.g: DM sent with paystub + relocation confirmation. Relocation date = 2026-02-10. No state election was filed.

sara: Looping in payroll policy: @ben — if withholding needs to be split across two states for the calendar year, what's the usual path? W-2 split or W-2c later?

ben: Short answer: we try to correct in payroll first (retro allocation on next payrun) if timing allows. If incorrect amounts remain at year-end, we process a W-2c or advise the employee on state refund filings. Payroll will need proof of relocation date and the exact pay periods to split.

ana: Quick update — ran a recalculation for Feb with relocation effective 2026-02-10. We created reversing entries to remove CA withholding for days after 2/10 and applied NY withholding for that portion. You'll see a correcting line on your next paycheck. If the net becomes negative we'll issue a separate reimbursement check. If year-to-date CA withholding still exceeds liability at year close we'll evaluate W-2c.

maria.g: Incredible, thank you! Any ETA on when the correcting line posts?

ana: It should appear on the next scheduled payrun (Mar 5). I'll keep PR-1123 open until you confirm receipt. Please flag here if the paystub still looks off after Mar 5.

maria.g: Will do — hugely appreciated :tada:

ana: Closing note on docs: for our records we uploaded the relocation proof to the payroll ticket and queued the state election form link to be sent to the employee so future runs use NY withholding.

ana: Closing the ticket if no further issues — reopen PR-1123 or ping me directly.
